test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 16 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Among the following pairs of lakes and the states in which they are located, which one has been INCORRECTLY paired?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Kolleru Lake -Maharashtra.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kollerru Lake** is not situated in Maharashtra it is basically situated in **Andhra Pradesh.**
 
• It lies between the **Godavari and Krishna river deltas** near the city of** Eluru.**
 
• It is also called **Colair Lake.**
 
• **Pulicat is a saltwater lake in Andhra Pradesh.**
